resources.string: Not the device owner. To set up, run this from a computer with USB debugging on:

To undo this setup: first delete the restricted user (Settings → System → Users), then tap Deactivate. Deactivate only affects this Owner profile. A user created here keeps its restrictions until it is deleted.
This removes Odysseus as device owner. Setting it up again needs the ADB command, and works only when the phone has no other users or accounts.
